data.long_meaning: The name Bud has Old English origins, derived from the term 'budde,' meaning 'pal' or 'friend.' In the 15th and 16th centuries, Bud was also used as a nickname for the given name Edward or Edwin. In modern usage, Bud can be used as a given name for both boys and girls, but it is most commonly used as a masculine name. The name Bud carries the meaning “Pal or friend” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Bud usually hope their child will grow to embody pal or friend and live with faith, good character and purpose.
